title: Chapter 497
text:
The fleet floated quietly above the sanctuary like a flying fortress. The people on the ground looked up and could only see the bottom of the spaceship and the circular anti-gravity stabilizers shining with blue light.

This was not the first time the players of Planet Aquamarine had seen a spaceship with their own eyes. When Han Xiao left Planet Aquamarine, a spaceship had descended once before. Now, history was repeating itself. However, it was not a single spaceship but a fleet!

Although spaceships could be seen everywhere in Pork Bun's video of the Black Star Mercenary conquering the galaxy, the shock was even more intense when seen up close.

Hundreds of thousands of players looked up with excitement and amazement. Many of them had been recording.

The power Han Xiao displayed was far beyond the past, but he did not make a move himself. To be able to command so many strong people, he must be even stronger. The question was, how strong was he?

The players all used [Detect] on Han Xiao, but the information they got was still full of question marks. The danger level was still [Extremely Fatal]. This was like a feather that tickled the hearts of many players. They were extremely curious about Han Xiao's strength.

Ahhh, I really want to know!

"My spaceship is parked above the sanctuary. You don't have any objections, right?" Han Xiao turned his head and said to the dumbfounded Huang Yu. His expression was calm, and his tone was as if he was saying, "It's nothing."

Huang Yu shook his head like a rattle-drum and wiped off his cold sweat. This was not a question of whether he had any objections, it was clearly whether he dared to have any objections!

Han Xiao looked at Bennett and said, "Let's go, let's talk."

"This, this …"

Bennett was shocked. They had not seen each other for two years, and Han Xiao kept giving him surprises. What exactly did Black Phantom experience in the galaxy?

A sense of anticipation grew from the bottom of his heart. Black Phantom said that he went to the galaxy to find a solution to the disaster. Now that he was back, he should have found it, right?

The crowd was crowded. The group passed through the crowd and headed toward the core area of the sanctuary.

Han Xiao first dealt with Bennett's problem and left the players aside. There was no need to be so impatient. After all, the leeks planted in the ground would not run away.

Let the impact of the return brew among the players first. This was the same logic as letting bullets fly for a while. Han Technician was never impatient. Being impatient would not yield ripe crops.

…

Han Xiao let the mercenaries wait outside and only brought the officers into the meeting room.

Yi Yeqing had been waiting there for a long time. She looked at Han Xiao with a complicated expression and asked the question that had always been on her mind. "When you exchanged me from Bell of Death Island, I did not believe that your reason was true. I was not the only pharmacist, but you chose me. Did you already know that I could make inhibitors?"

"Take a guess." Han Xiao did not answer.

Yi Yeqing frowned. She did not mind being used for her freedom, but she hated the feeling of being kept in the dark. She wanted to ask more questions, but when she saw Han Xiao's eyes, she felt a sense of pressure that penetrated deep into her heart. It was as if a huge rock was pressing down on her chest.

Han Xiao's aura was much stronger than before. She bit her lips and did not dare to be rash like before. She swallowed her words.

Bennett cleared his throat and continued the conversation. "As you can see, the disaster that you predicted has indeed happened. We call it the Mutation Disaster. I hope that you came back because you found a solution. With Blue Star's technology, there is no way to solve it. Even the mutation virus could not be discovered."

"Tell me about the situation."

Han Xiao nodded. Because of his influence, the process of Blue Star encountering the Mutation Disaster was very different from his previous life. For example, there was no Sanctuary Three in his previous life. Although the exact storyline was different, the core of the matter was the same, the Mutation Disaster. If he could grasp the core, he would not be afraid of the storyline changing.

Using ten minutes, Bennett explained the current situation of Blue Star to Han Xiao.

"The situation is still optimistic. I came back just in time," Han Xiao said.

Bennett paused for a moment before asking, "What did you experience in the universe?"

He finally had the chance to ask. He wanted to know how Han Xiao had built his organization, what had happened, what was his current identity, and so on.

"I am now a mercenary. These are my companions." Han Xiao pointed at the officers who were playing Wayne Cards in boredom. Herlous and Harmon were in a deadlock.

This group of good-for-nothings could not be serious. They were not concerned about the situation of the disaster. After all, their captain would deal with it. What was there to worry about?

Han Xiao briefly described his experience, but Bennett was still amazed. The vastness of the universe was far beyond his imagination.

Although he had stayed in Blue Star because of his responsibilities, Bennett could not lie to his heart. He also yearned for the sea of stars.

Bang!

At this moment, the door suddenly opened, and Aurora rushed in. Her gaze passed through the officers and saw Han Xiao sitting by the table. Her face was filled with joy, and she ran into Han Xiao's embrace, hugging his waist tightly.

"You are finally back! I missed you so much! "

Aurora rubbed against Han Xiao's chest like a kitten, revealing a relieved expression. Other than Hella, she was the closest to Han Xiao.

The petite body in his embrace was warm and gave off a light fragrance. Seeing Aurora so close to him, Han Xiao could not push her away. He smiled helplessly and could only let her hug him. He reached out and patted Aurora's head, smiling gently. "You have changed … cough cough, grown up."

Aurora's appearance had changed a lot compared to two years ago. Two years ago, she was thin and weak, her skin was pale, and she even had to race in a wheelchair. Now, her skin was white and rosy, and she was very healthy. Her blonde hair was dazzling and beautiful, and she had also grown taller. When she rushed over just now, she was full of energy and did not even need a wheelchair.

Her ability gave her a strong vitality, and she was full of vitality.

This scene immediately attracted the attention of the officers at the side, and they all looked over in shock.

Who was this woman? She was actually so close to Black Star. Could it be that the team leader had already gotten married in his hometown?

Han Xiao let Aurora hug him for a few seconds, then helped her up and asked, "Where is your sister?"

"I brought her here. She didn't want to look for you." Aurora giggled.

Ta ta ta …

Hella walked into the room, looked at Han Xiao, and said indifferently, "You are willing to come back?"

"I came back because I couldn't bear to."

Han Xiao felt a sense of resentment from her, and he was a little surprised.

Hella did not say anything, took out an item, and threw it over.

Pa.

Han Xiao caught it and looked at it. It was the key to the secret hiding place that he had left for Hella.

"Your key." Hella said.

"No, it's your key." Han Xiao threw it back.

Hella caught it and threw it back to Han Xiao again, and lowered her eyes, "Since you are back, you don't need this key."

Originally, this key was meant for Hila to use when she was in danger. Now that she had said this, it was clear that she believed that she would not be in danger after Han Xiao returned. Although she did not say it out loud, it vaguely expressed her thoughts.

"… You trust me so much?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, "Then why didn't you leave with me?"

"That is my freedom." Hella pursed her lips, looked at the officers, and glanced at them, pausing for a moment on Aroshia, Sylvia, and Ginette.

"I thought you would be happy to see me." Han Xiao was helpless.

"Who are you to me? Why should I be happy?" Hella asked back.

At this time, Sylvia said unhappily, "Teacher came back to save you. How dare you speak to him like that?"

As soon as she said that, everyone looked over with strange expressions.

Sylvia did not understand. She shrunk her neck, and her tone lowered subconsciously, "W-why are you looking at me? Did I say anything wrong? "

"Shut up." Herlous rolled his eyes, "Come back and play cards."

This girl was not observant at all. What did it have to do with her when the regiment commander was talking to an acquaintance from his hometown? Anyone with a discerning eye could see that this red-haired woman was being arrogant. Why couldn't she just stay in the background? No one would treat her as a mute if she did not speak.

Thud thud thud …

Bennett tapped his fingers on the table, his face full of dissatisfaction, "Hella, stop messing around. We are talking about serious matters."

"Humph." Hella walked over and sat down beside Han Xiao.

She then casually flicked a weak dark red stream of air at Bennett's face, unhappy that he used the word 'messing around'.

The moment she sat down, she picked up the pure black mask that Han Xiao had placed on the table and played with it. This mask reminded her of the Germinal Organization leader. However, thinking about that man now, Hella would not lose control of her anger. Two years had passed since the incident, and she was much calmer. She was no longer easily agitated by the past.

"Cough cough, let's get back to the topic …" Bennett rubbed his numb face and said with a serious tone.

"Do you have a way to solve the Mutation Disaster?"

Han Xiao tapped his fingers on the table slowly, looked at everyone's expectant eyes, and smiled.

"Yes."

—
